maxEventsPerSource.title: Default max events per source
maxEventsPerSource.description: Fallback cap for Eventbrite, Partiful, and Luma when their own caps are not set.

maxEventbriteEvents.title: Max Eventbrite events
maxEventbriteEvents.description: Maximum Eventbrite events to collect. Leave empty to use the default.

maxPartifulEvents.title: Max Partiful events
maxPartifulEvents.description: Maximum Partiful events to collect. Leave empty to use the default. Partiful events are dropped by the address filter.

maxLumaEvents.title: Max Luma events
maxLumaEvents.description: Maximum Luma events to collect. Leave empty to use the default.

maxDoTheBayEvents.title: Max DoTheBay events
maxDoTheBayEvents.description: Maximum DoTheBay events to keep. 0 means no cap.

daysAhead.title: Days ahead (DoTheBay)
daysAhead.description: How many days of DoTheBay San Francisco listings to read, starting today.

eventbriteCity.title: Eventbrite city slug
eventbriteCity.description: City slug used for Eventbrite (country is fixed to United States).
